title: ZynAsk Anthem
style: 178 BPM happy hardcore, fast kick, vocal hook chop, piano riff lead, joyful and pounding, dancefloor-built, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — kick + sped-up vocal sample]
Z-Y-N
Ask
Before
Assume

[Verse 1 — kick locked]
Three letters before the move
Three letters before the groove
Three letters that saved the catalog
Three letters that closed the bog
Z-Y-N — Ask
Z-Y-N — Task
The doctrine in three letters
The factory in three asks

[Build — piano riff doubles]
ZynAsk
ZynAsk
ZynAsk
ZynAsk!

[Drop — anthem]
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THREE LETTERS, ONE LAW!
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THE OPERATOR'S DRAW!
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THE CLAUDE OBEYS THE CALL!

[Verse 2 — faster vocal chops]
Before the rm — ZynAsk
Before the move — ZynAsk
Before the cleanup — ZynAsk
Before the chat-build — ZynAsk
The AI that asks is the AI that lasts
The AI that assumes is the AI that crashes

[Breakdown — vocal chop loop]
Z.
Y.
N.
Ask.
Z.
Y.
N.
Ask.

[Final Drop — full pound]
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THE CLAUDE THAT CARES!
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THE OPERATOR'S CHAIRS!
ZYNASK ANTHEM!
THE LAW NEVER WEARS!

[Outro — kick fades]
Z. Y. N.
Ask.
Always.
End.
